purpose: Observe deployed HTTP crawl-access and public multilingual alternate relationships separately from search-engine indexing.

policy.selection: Existing public Google/Bing observation targets only; no private drafts.
policy.transport: At most two ordinary identified HTTP requests concurrently; no automatic server redirects or extra alternate fetching.
checks: HTML and scoped/repeated HTTP index directives
Published edition coverage and reciprocal hreflang
policy.unknown: Unrecognized robots policy, conditional directives, transport errors and unobserved alternates are not passes.
policy.privacy: New private mode-600 output outside all worktrees; no cookies, credentials, complete headers or HTML bodies.

limits: Ordinary HTTP observations do not prove access by real authenticated search crawlers, indexing, rankings or exposure.
This is not a complete robots parser or search-engine directive interpreter.
No JavaScript, Analytics events, submission requests, automatic schedules or content publication.
